Breaking Down the Ending of Love in Disguise

In an era that’s seen the K-drama industry shift focus toward more stories of suspense, thriller, and crime , the romantic comedy Love in Disguise marks a return to a familiar K-drama trope. The series, streaming on Prime Video stars Squid Game ’ s Yim Si-wan as Yoon Yi-joon, the heir apparent to the powerful Taekang Group.
